pass_condition: Primary, per domain B, C and D, for the fused detector of indomain-x, all three: (1) at most 1% of benign test queries alert; (2) at least 90% of attack test queries alert; (3) every attack_technique value with at least 1,000 attack test queries has at least 75% alerting. Headline: the number of domains (of B, C, D) that pass. Indomain-a is reported against the same condition as a replication. Fewshot, lodo and drift arms have no pass condition; their benign alert rates and detection rates are reported, with the lodo and drift expectations above checked as stated.
